document_title: A Falsifiable Cross-Modal Program for the Microscopic Mechanism of Cuprate High-Temperature Superconductivity

quantitative_disclosure.interpretation_boundary: The reduced pairing-kernel calculation compares declared phenomenological scenarios only; it neither fits a cuprate data set nor establishes a microscopic pairing mechanism.

literature_boundary.excluded_historical_claim: Snider et al. (2020) is cited only to record the 2022 retraction and is not used as mechanism or room-temperature-superconductivity support.

prohibited_interpretations: The calculation is not an empirical fit.
The calculation is not a material-specific Tc prediction.
The calculation does not prove a spin-fluctuation mechanism.
The report does not assert a universal high-temperature-superconductivity mechanism.
